SERVICE_HEADLINE: Reseda Boulevard, six days a week
TAGLINE: General auto repair on Reseda Blvd, open Saturday mornings for the jobs that cannot wait until Monday.
SERVICES_INTRO: The everyday work that keeps a car on the road, without an appointment three weeks out.
SERVICE_1_BODY: Brakes, batteries, belts and the faults that appear on the way to work.
SERVICE_2_BODY: Oil, filters and fluids at sensible intervals, with a look at what will need doing next.
SERVICE_3_BODY: Open Saturday morning, which is when most people actually have time to leave a car.
WHY_INTRO: There are other shops within a few minutes of here. This is what a customer actually notices.
WHY_1_BODY: The quote comes before the work, and nothing gets done without you agreeing to it.
WHY_2_BODY: A person picks up during opening hours, and a missed call gets returned the same day.
WHY_3_BODY: Whatever came off the car is there to look at if you want to see it.
CONTACT_INTRO: Call for anything urgent. For a quote or a booking the form reaches the desk directly.
